chapter.verse: Stephen a kithah vai Saul in thukimpih hi. Tua ni-in Jerusalem khua pawlpi' tungah bawlsiatna lianpi tung a, sawltakte losiah amaute a vekun Judea gam leh Samaria gam sung mun citeng ah kithehthang uh hi.
Thuzui citakte in Stephen vui uh a, ama' hangin nakpi-in kah la awi uh hi.
Ahi zongin Saul in pawlpi suksiat ding hanciam a, inn khatkhit khat ah lutin numei pasal, a kua cilo kaikhia-in thong ah ap hi.
Tu-in a kithehthang teng pai kawikawi-in Lungdamna Thu tangko uh hi.
Philip zong Samaria mite' khuapi ah paisuk a, tuate' kiangah Khris thu tangko hi
Tua ciangin mihonpi in Philip' thugen za-in ama' bawl kihilna limte a muh uh ciangin ama' genkhiat thute lungsim kikhatin thudon uh hi.
A hang pen kha ninte awging lianpi tawh kiko-in amau' luahna mi tampite sungpan pusuak uh a, pumzaw leh khebai mi tampi dam ahih man hi.
Tua hangin tua khuapi ah nakpi nuamna om hi.
Ahi zongin tua hun ma-in khuapi sungah mitphial lakin Samaria mite lamdang a sasak, amahmah mithupi khatin a kigentawm, Simon minnei mi khat om hi.
A neupen pan a lianpen dong a vekun Simon thudon uh a, “Hih mipa pen Pasian' vangliatna, ‘Thupi’ a kici pen ahi hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua mipa in a mitphial siamna tawh mite lamdang a saksak sawtvei khin ahih manin mite in amah thudon uh hi.
Ahih hangin Philip in Pasian' kumpigam vai leh Jesu Khris' min vai Lungdamna Thu a tangko ciangin amaute in um uh a, numei pasal kibaptize uh hi.
Simon nangawn in um a, a kibaptize khit ciangin Philip zuisuak hi. Kihilna lim leh nalamdang a kibawlte a muh ciangin lamdang sa mahmah hi.
Tu-in Jerusalem khua-a sawltakte in Samaria mite Pasian' thu sang uh cih thu, a zak uh ciangin Peter leh John paisak uh hi.
Sawltakte nih a tun uh ciangin Samaria mite Kha Siangtho a ngah nadingun thungetsak uh hi.
(A hang pen amaute Topa Jesu' min tawh a kibaptize khin ciang bek uh hi a, kuama' tungah Kha Siangtho tung nailo hi.)
Tua ciangin amaute' tungah khut a ngak uh ciangin Kha Siangtho ngah uh hi.
Tua bangin sawltakte' khutngakna tawh Kha kingah cih a muh ciangin Simon in sawltakte' kiangah sum luui a,
“Kei zong khut ka ngak mite in Kha Siangtho a ngah theih nadingin hih bang hihtheihna hong pia un,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in, “Na sum tawh siakhawm ta in! A hang pen Pasian' deihguat thupha, sum tawh a lei thei ding na kisa hi.
Pasian' muhna ah na lungsim tang lo ahih manin hih thu ah sehtan ahi-a panmun ahi zongin na nei kei hi.
Tua ahih manin hih na khansiatna kisik inla na lungsim sawmna hong maisak theihkhak ding leh Topa' kiangah thum in.
A hang pen a siahuai enna lungsim leh diklohna kol sungah om na hihlam kong mu hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Simon in, “Na gen thute khat zong kei' tung hong tun loh nadingin Topa' kiangah thu hong ngetsak in,” ci hi.
Tua bangin sawltakte in khauhtakin teci pangin Topa' thu a gen khit uh ciangin Jerusalem ah ciah uh a, tua kawmin Samaria khuata tampi ah Lungdamna Thu tangko uh hi.
Tu-in Topa' vanmi khat in Philip' kiangah, “Kithawi inla leitawlam, Jerusalem pan Gaza paisukna lampi ah pai in,” ci hi. (Tua mun pen gamgawtak lak ahi hi.)

Philip zong kithawi-in pai hi. Tua takah, en un, Ethiopia mi khat na om hi. Amah pen Ethiopia kumpinu Candace' neihlelam khempeuh a van, ulian mangpi, mi kiget khat hi a, Pasian bia dingin Jerusalem a va pai,
tu-in a ciahlam, leeng tungah tuangin kamsang Isaiah laibu a sim laitak, ahi hi.
Kha in Philip' kiangah, “Hong pai inla hih leeng hong neh in,” ci hi.
Philip zong tua mipa' kiangah va tai a, Isaiah kamsangpa' laibu a sim a zak ciangin, “Na sim thu na tel hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Ulian mangpa in, “Hong hilh khat a om lohin koici tel zawh mawk ding ka hi hiam?” ci a, ama' kiangah a kahto dingin leh a tukhawm dingin Philip sam hi.
Tua ama' sim Pasian' Laibu a mun pen hih ahi hi: “Tuu bangin gawh dingin amah kipaipih a, mulmetpa' mai-ah a gamdai tuuno bangin amah zong a kam ka lo hi.
Amah kisimmawhin thumaan ngahkha lo hi. Leitung pan a nuntakna kilakhia ahih manin ama' suanlekhakte' thu kua in sutkik thei ding ahi hiam?”
Tua ciangin ulian mangpa in Philip' kiangah, “Kamsangpa' gen kua' thu ahi hiam? Ama' thu hiam, midang khatpeuh' thu hiam? Hong gen dih in,” ci-in dong hi.
Tua ciangin Philip kamka a, tua Pasian' Laibu mun pan kipanin Jesu tawh kisai Lungdamna Thu pulak hi.
Tua bangin lampi dung a zuih laitakun tui omna khat tung uh a, ulian mangpa in, “Hih takah tui om! Ka kibaptize loh nading bang in hong khaktan ahi hiam?” ci hi.
(Philip in, “Na lungsim bup tawh na up leh na kibaptize thei hi,” ci hi. Ulian mangpa in, “Jesu Khris pen Pasian' Tapa hi ci-in ka um hi,” cikik hi.)
Tua ciangin ulian mangpa in leeng a khawl nadingin thupia a, Philip leh ulian mangpa a nihun tui omna ah paisukin Philip in amah baptize hi.
Tui sungpan hong paitoh uh ciangin Topa' Kha in Philip tuahkhia hi. Ulian mangpa in amah mu nawnlo a, himah taleh lungdamna tawh a khualzin zomsuak hi.
Philip ahihleh Azotus ah a tung nahi gige a, Caesarea a tun dongin lamkal khua citeng ah Lungdamna Thu tangko hi.
